units.source_text: 内藏助突然反常发言，言语流利。

en.t: Kuranosuke suddenly said something out of character, and his words came smoothly.

units.source_text: 这是因为虽然受到了一点感染，但是他的内心深处还充斥着志得意满的情绪。

en.t: This was because, although he had been affected a little, his innermost heart was still filled with a triumphant sense of satisfaction.
